test_subset_column_selection: test DataFrame column subset selection with Copy-on-Write behavior when modifying the subset
test_subset_row_slice: test DataFrame row slice subset with Copy-on-Write behavior when modifying the subset
test_subset_chained_getitem: test chained indexing operations maintain Copy-on-Write guarantees without modifying the parent DataFrame
test_del_frame: test del operator on DataFrame columns maintains Copy-on-Write behavior and updates references
test_column_as_series: test selecting a single column as Series with Copy-on-Write behavior when modifying the series
test_null_slice: test null slice indexing operations return new objects and trigger Copy-on-Write when mutated
test_series_getitem_slice: test Series slicing with Copy-on-Write behavior when modifying the subset series
test_subset_set_column: test setting a single column value on a viewing DataFrame subset with Copy-on-Write
test_subset_set_columns: test setting multiple column values on a viewing DataFrame subset with Copy-on-Write
